chapter: Earl King, later career and gear
title: Recording Big Chief with Professor Longhair
summary: Studio session details, Fess's playing, Earl King singing, Wardell's rearrangement.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: And you were on Big Chief with Professor Longhead. Yeah, I was playing on the piano.
I always have a question about that song.

I think I was going to ask Wardell. I was going to ask Wardell this? That lick that Fess plays, you know, that he plays on the piano? Yeah. Now, did Earl write that or did Fess write that lick? Or did you know who wrote that lick? No, well, I think Fess just come up with that itself. You think so? Yeah. That's his style, I think. But what happened, man, Fess had us in the studio down there all night with that.

The recording it looked like almost because he's the only one who wasn't reading, you know. Well, see, Fess was supposed to originally sing it, but he couldn't sing it and play it at the same time where he was playing. And so Earl wound up singing it. That's Earl singing and whistling. So Earl just wound up singing it, you know. But then another thing with Fess, the man stopped Fess from playing his left hand. Because he's playing this one hand. Because see what he was playing with his left hand in the bass was interfering with the figure I was playing. It was interfering with that. And then he stopped, he put a pillow down there by his foot because he had to have the kick in the piano, you know. When he was playing at the Caledonia Inn years ago there at the upright piano, he kicked a spot in there. And you see them baby grinds, he kicked a pedal where the pedal come down, you know.
So I don't think he used the pedal at all. I don't think he used the pedal.
No, no. He kicked. And so what he was doing there was interfering with where Smoke was playing on the drum. So the man put a pedal down there, you know. But it all come out good, though.

Now before Walter did a ramming on it, I had a ramming on it. You know. When I tried to get the cast together on it, man, I couldn't get them a rehearsal. And they think I know where I would and got Walter to do another ramming. Of course it wasn't the same thing. You know, the ramming wise, because you know two rangers don't think alike.
